results.title: Tension rises over CLOGSAG Oti Regional elections after aspirant’s disqualification
results.description: Tension has emerged at the ongoing Civil and Local Government Staff Association of Ghana (CLOGSAG) regional elections in Dambai, Oti Region, following the disqualification of a chairmanship aspirant and concerns raised over the conduct of the electoral process.
